title: Round to a multiple of 16
task: The word at x (0x800) is unsigned. Store x rounded down to a multiple of 16 at down (0x804), and x rounded up to a multiple of 16 at up (0x808), modulo 2^32; then end with B . . Use only the base processor's instructions (ADD, SUB, AND, ORR, LDR, STR and B, each with a condition and with S) and immediates 0 to 255, so that the program also runs in the three processor views in the base design. x AND 15 is what lies above the multiple below x; the base processor has no BIC, so subtract it. Keep the .equ lines: the tests write the data at those addresses.
starter:
; round-16 -- practice exercise (MAVILERA, ARMv7)
; Store x rounded down and up to a multiple of 16.
; Hint: AND with 15, SUB, then a conditional ADD.
        .equ  x, 0x800          ; the tests write and read here
        .equ  down, 0x804       ; the tests write and read here
        .equ  up, 0x808         ; the tests write and read here

done:   B     done           ; replace with your code; B . ends the run
